caption:
You don't need more leads to make more money.

You might already have them sitting in your pipeline.

Open the Revenue Calculator and run your numbers twice. First: 20% more monthly leads at your current close rate. Second: your same lead count, but a 20% higher close rate.

For many service businesses, the close rate scenario comes out ahead. Ad spend buys you leads. Follow-up buys you the close rate.

Four numbers, no signup, no card.

rationale: Single-offer promo images still book the fastest DM response for one clear ask, and this cycles the Revenue Calculator back into rotation with an unclaimed 'leads vs. close rate' lever comparison distinct from its prior dollar-gap angle.
